raw_message.reasoning:
Pytest version may not support some options. We can run tests by ignoring config. Use 'pytest -q --maxfail=1' maybe. But we can run tests with '-q' ignoring config? Actually the error arises because pytest doesn't recognize --no-cov-on-fail etc. That is from pytest-cov plugin maybe not installed. So tests fail.

But we can run tests by invoking 'pytest -q --maxfail=1' but still config will be read. To avoid config, we can set PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 environment variable. Let's run with that.
